decisions.reason: The multi-model plug-in line builds directly on the established offer, has its own page and carries substantial sunk development, so management persists with it.

The building digital twin service fits the announced direction of enterprise-integrated geospatial IT, and its modest visibility can still be explained by a market that is still forming, so management keeps it.
The authentication and delegation service is close to the core offer and complements the publicly announced identity service, so dropping it would undercut earlier commitments.
The open GIS framework is a multi-model line with heavy sunk investment and is central to the firm's open, extensible strategy, so commitment remains high.
The identity service was publicly announced as new and is strategically tied to seamless GeoIT integration, so this visible commitment favors continuing it.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, builds on established consulting expertise and is cheap to keep, so it stays while results develop.
